name: 农药安全间隔期倒计时

map.选择农药并输入施药日期，计算安全采收倒计时（PHI安全间隔期数据仅供参考）: Pick a pesticide and enter the application date to compute the safe-harvest countdown (PHI data for reference only)
map.📖 查看「农药安全间隔期倒计时使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pesticide Pre-Harvest Interval Countdown Guide"
map.安全间隔期(PHI)指最后一次施药至收获之间必须间隔的最短天数。实际请以农药标签: The Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) is the minimum days between the last application and harvest. Follow the pesticide label; this tool is for reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：农药安全间隔期倒计时: 📚 Deep Dive: Pesticide Pre-Harvest Interval Countdown
map.可采日 = 末次施药日 + 安全间隔期（PHI，天）。: Harvest day = last application day + PHI (days).
map.不同药剂、作物 PHI 不同（标签注明）。: Different agents and crops have different PHI (on the label).
map.用于保障农产品残留达标。: Used to keep produce residue within limits.
map.9 月 1 日喷施某杀虫剂，标签 PHI 7 天，则最早可采日 = 9 月 8: Sprayed an insecticide on Sep 1, label PHI 7 days, earliest harvest = Sep 8. If pests found and re-sprayed on Sep 5, harvest shifts to Sep 12, restart the clock.
map.最后一次施药到作物可安全采收的最短天数，确保残留降解到限量以下。是农药标签的法定: The minimum days from last application to safe harvest, ensuring residue degrades below the limit. A legal label requirement; violation means over-limit risk.
map.下雨冲掉药要重喷吗？: If rain washes off the pesticide, re-spray?
map.施药后短时降雨会减效，但是否重喷看药剂与间隔。重喷会延长 PHI，临近采收应谨慎: Short rain after application reduces effect, but re-spray depends on agent and interval. Re-spray extends PHI; near harvest be cautious, prefer low-risk treatment.
map.⏰ 农药安全间隔期倒计时。农业种植工具，帮助计算种植参数与产量。: ⏰ Pesticide Pre-Harvest Interval Countdown. An agricultural tool that helps calculate planting parameters and yield.
